## 2026-10 {#press-2026-10}

[↑ Back to timeline](#press-timeline){.press-back}

- []{#press-item-2026-10-07-slatms .press-item}**7 Oct 2026 · 星島頭條 / 香港商報:** CAD Deputy DG Dominic Chow (許文豪) outlines the Smart Low-altitude Traffic Management System (SLATMS) at the police Smart Policing Advisory Group’s 7th meeting. [Link](https://www.stheadline.com/breaking-news/3623364/%E6%B7%B1%E7%A0%94%E6%99%BA%E8%83%BD%E7%84%A1%E4%BA%BA%E9%9B%86%E7%BE%A4-%E5%BC%95%E9%A0%98%E6%9C%AA%E4%BE%86%E8%AD%A6%E6%94%BF%E5%89%8D%E6%B2%BF%E6%8A%80%E8%A1%93-%E7%B6%AD%E8%AD%B7%E5%9F%8E%E5%B8%82%E5%AE%89%E5%85%A8%E9%9F%8C%E6%80%A7) · [香港商報](https://www.hkcd.com.hk/hkcdweb/content/2026/10/07/content_8778765.html)
  - What's new: CAD outlined SLATMS as an automated pre-/in-/post-flight digital stack with data interfaces for future cross-boundary and meteorological exchange (press report of official remarks; no GIA found).
  - Status: Smart TMS / SLATMS still research stage; Policy Address / STL still point to 2028 initial service. Not a new legal instrument.
  - Read instead: [STL LegCo EDev Panel GIA 2026-10-02](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202610/02/P2026100200677.htm) (Smart TMS from 2028); Policy Address Smart TMS framing.

  ::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="原文 · Chinese original"}
  [「民航處副處長許文豪介紹了香港『智能低空交通管理系統』（Smart Low-altitude Traffic Management System (SLATMS）) 的相關技術，設計概念及配套服務。……隨着無人機數量與密度上升……必須以自動化、高度數碼化的方式管理低空空域，實現『機器對機器』的資訊交換……SLATMS 的核心技術在於建立高度數碼化的流程，涵蓋飛行前、飛行中與飛行後三個階段：包括飛行計劃申報與審批、實時監測與衝突預警，以及數據記錄與分析。……系統亦需建立數據交換介面，支援跨境運作及氣象與地理資訊交換」]{lang="zh-Hant"} ([source](https://www.stheadline.com/breaking-news/3623364/%E6%B7%B1%E7%A0%94%E6%99%BA%E8%83%BD%E7%84%A1%E4%BA%BA%E9%9B%86%E7%BE%A4-%E5%BC%95%E9%A0%98%E6%9C%AA%E4%BE%86%E8%AD%A6%E6%94%BF%E5%89%8D%E6%B2%BF%E6%8A%80%E8%A1%93-%E7%B6%AD%E8%AD%B7%E5%9F%8E%E5%B8%82%E5%AE%89%E5%85%A8%E9%9F%8C%E6%80%A7))
  :::

- **6 Oct 2026 · 政府新聞公報 (Chinese GIA):** SCED tells LegCo the UAS spectrum licensing regime aligns with Mainland planning, aiding future cross-boundary drone operations.
  - What's new: Cross-border 6G trials covering LAE will be encouraged.
  - Status: Restatement; licensing regime unchanged since October 2025; Shenzhen–HK corridor still not evidenced.
  - Read instead: [this GIA release](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202610/06/P2026100600265.htm); [UAS (Private) Licence launch, 27 Oct 2025](#press-item-2025-10-27-uas-licence).

  ::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="原文 · Chinese original"}
  [「低空經濟發展方面，通訊事務管理局（通訊局）已於二○二五年十月推出使用無人機系統專用頻譜的發牌制度。有關安排與內地的頻譜規劃一致，有助日後無人機跨境運作。」…「政府會積極鼓勵業界拓展跨境6G技術試驗及應用場景驗證，包括低軌衞星、低空經濟等，以達到粵港澳大灣區、香港及業界三贏局面。」]{lang="zh-Hant"} ([source](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202610/06/P2026100600265.htm))
  :::

- **6 Oct 2026 · The Standard:** CAD follows up a Mainland blogger’s alleged drone flight from The Peak over the Victoria Harbour restricted flying zone. [Link](https://www.thestandard.com.hk/news/article/344668/Mainland-blogger-flies-drone-over-Victoria-Harbour-to-film-National-Day-fireworks-CAD-following-up)
  - What's new: Flight allegedly filmed the 1 October National Day fireworks without permission.
  - Status: Enforcement only, no new instrument; penalty restated (max HK$100,000 fine, two years’ imprisonment).
  - Read instead: Cap. 448G (Small Unmanned Aircraft Order) / restricted flying zones.

- []{#press-item-2026-10-05-sandbox-connect .press-item}**5 Oct 2026 · China Daily Hong Kong:** TLB and CAD describe “Sandbox Connect”, Hong Kong’s first cross-jurisdictional LAE trial under Sandbox X. [Link](https://www.chinadailyhk.com/hk/article/640531)
  - What's new: Nansha as gateway; joint regulatory testing framework under design; longer-term “LAE regulatory green channel” goal.
  - Status: Press framing only; Sandbox X cross-boundary results still open; Shenzhen–HK corridor still not evidenced.
  - Read instead: Regulatory Sandbox X (TLB).

- []{#press-item-2026-10-02-stl-edev .press-item}**2 Oct 2026 · 政府新聞公報 (Chinese GIA):** STL Chan briefs LegCo’s Economic Development Panel on Five-Year Plan / Policy Address transport measures.
  - What's new: Unconventional-aircraft bill to be drafted and submitted next year; Smart TMS rollout from 2028.
  - Status: >140 regularised projects (PA 2026 ¶137) is the Regulatory Sandbox regularisation count, not Sandbox X results; Action Plan still being drafted.
  - Read instead: [this GIA release](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202610/02/P2026100200677.htm); Action Plan on Developing Low-Altitude Economy (text open); Cap. 448G / >150 kg drafting.

  ::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="原文 · Chinese original"}
  [「現時，我們已透過「監管沙盒」將超過140個項目恆常化。今年，發展低空經濟工作組會繼續全力制訂《發展低空經濟規劃行動綱領》。我們承諾於明年完成為非傳統航空器制訂專屬法例的草擬工作，並提交立法會。此外，我們會同步積極構建智能低空交通管理系統，目標是二○二八年起逐步落實並推展。」]{lang="zh-Hant"} ([source](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202610/02/P2026100200677.htm))
  :::

- **30 Sep 2026 · 紫荊 / Bau.com.hk:** CAD Director-General Clara Wong’s bylined civil-aviation feature includes a dedicated LAE section. [Link](https://bau.com.hk/web/article/1554875572736425984/web/content_1554875572736425984.html)
  - What's new: Dedicated >150 kg legislation: drafting to begin (PA ¶139) and be completed within 2027, then submitted to LegCo (indicator 35; STL 2026-10-02).
  - Status: Recap, no new instrument (Cap. 448G Category C since mid-2025; Cap. 448C trial provisions; Smart TMS research).
  - Read instead: Cap. 448G / >150 kg drafting; CAD SUA; Working Group.

  ::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="原文 · Chinese original"}
  [「首階段法例修訂工作已於2025年7月生效，包括擴大《小型無人機令》（第448G章）的規管範圍，以涵蓋重量超過25公斤至150公斤的丙類小型無人機，並於《1995 年飛航（香港）令》（第 448C 章）新增條文，為非傳統航空器在特定條件下的試飛提供法律依據。」…「民航處借鑑“監管沙盒”的實踐經驗及不同地區的良好做法，積極研究智能低空交通管理系統。」…「民航處已著手研究在《民航條例》（第448章）下，為重量超過150公斤的非傳統航空器訂立專門的附屬法例」…「全力爭取在2027年完成相關法例的草擬工作。」]{lang="zh-Hant"} ([source](https://bau.com.hk/web/article/1554875572736425984/web/content_1554875572736425984.html))
  :::

- []{#press-item-2026-09-26-gn5936 .press-item}**26 Sep 2026 · Civil Aviation Department (Gazette G.N. 5936):** Director-General designates Cap. 448G restricted flying zones to facilitate Low-Altitude Economy Regulatory Sandbox pilot projects; supersedes G.N. 4328 of 2026 (notice dated 21 Sep; effective 26 Sep). [Link](https://www.cad.gov.hk/documents/G.N.5936_E.pdf) · [中文](https://www.cad.gov.hk/documents/G.N.5936_C.pdf)
  - What's new: Official Gazette designation under Cap. 448G s.19(1) of named areas as RFZs for Sandbox facilitation. An airspace designation, not an amendment to Cap. 448G and not a count of Sandbox projects. CAD’s SUA listing page also labels it as superseding G.N. 927 of 2026 — contradiction with the PDF text (G.N. 4328); keep both labels OPEN pending clarification.
  - Status: Regulatory Sandbox airspace facilitation (not Sandbox X results). Official counts stay on Official status.
  - Read instead: Official status / Timeline: G.N. 5936; Cap. 448G RFZs.

  ::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="官方中英文本 · Official English and Chinese"}
  English: “By virtue of the authority under section 19(1) of the Small Unmanned Aircraft Order, Chapter 448G, I hereby designate the areas in Hong Kong (including the airspace above the areas) described below as restricted flying zones for the purposes of section 18(1) of the said Order:—” … “The designation made in this notice, which shall have effect at all times during a day, shall come into effect and supersede the designation made in G.N. 4328 of 2026 on 26 September 2026.” … “21 September 2026 — Clara Wong Director-General of Civil Aviation” ([source](https://www.cad.gov.hk/documents/G.N.5936_E.pdf))

  [「本人憑藉《小型無人機令》(第448G章)第19(1)條授予的權力，現就該命令第18(1)條，指定下列香港範圍(包括該範圍的空域)為限制飛行區：」…「本公告作出的指定將於2026年9月26日開始實施，全日生效，並同時取代2026年第4328號政府公告內作出的指定。」…「2026年9月21日 民航處處長黃嘉華」]{lang="zh-Hant"} ([source](https://www.cad.gov.hk/documents/G.N.5936_C.pdf))

- []{#press-item-2026-09-23-caac .press-item}**23 Sep 2026 · info.gov.hk (English GIA) / 政府新聞公報 (Chinese GIA):** STL Chan, TLB Permanent Secretary and CAD Director-General meet CAAC Deputy Administrator Liang Nan in Beijing.
  - What's new: Low-altitude economy listed among topics, alongside trunk-branch connectivity, air cargo and SAF.
  - Status: No new Action Plan text or corridor announcement; Shenzhen–HK corridor still not evidenced.
  - Read instead: [English GIA release](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202609/23/P2026092300422.htm) · [Chinese GIA release](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202609/23/P2026092300345.htm); Working Group / TLB / CAD; Action Plan (text open).

  ::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="官方中英文本 · Official English and Chinese"}
  English: “Together with the Permanent Secretary for Transport and Logistics, Mr Vic Yau, and the Director-General of Civil Aviation, Ms Clara Wong, Ms Chan called on the Civil Aviation Administration of China (CAAC) this morning to meet with Deputy Administrator of the CAAC Ms Liang Nan to keep her updated on Hong Kong\'s latest developments in aviation, including the objectives and policies in relation to aviation developments in Hong Kong\'s First Five-Year Plan and the 2026 Policy Address, and to discuss various measures including Hong Kong\'s active integration into the national strategy of \"Trunk-Branch Connectivity, Whole-Network Linkage\", enhancing the connectivity between Mainland cities and international destinations, consolidating the world-leading position of Hong Kong\'s air cargo industry, promoting the production and use of sustainable aviation fuel, as well as the low-altitude economy.” ([source](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202609/23/P2026092300422.htm))

  [「她今日上午聯同運輸及物流局常任秘書長丘卓恒和民航處處長黃嘉華拜訪中國民用航空局（國家民航局），與國家民航局副局長梁楠會面，闡述香港在航空方面的最新發展，包括在《香港第一個五年規劃》和二○二六年《施政報告》中與航空發展相關的目標與政策，並就香港積極融入國家「幹支通、全網聯」、提升內地城市與全球目的地高效連接、鞏固香港航空貨運業世界領先地位、推動可持續航空燃料生產及使用、低空經濟等各項措施商討。」]{lang="zh-Hant"} ([source](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202609/23/P2026092300345.htm))
  :::

  English (LAE-Intel translation): The 12 Measures on Financial Empowerment of High-Quality Development of the Low-Altitude Economy Industry in the Qianhai Shenzhen-Hong Kong Modern Service Industry Cooperation Zone are hereby printed; comply with them. … The Measures take effect from 1 September 2026 through 31 December 2028. … “Low-altitude economy enterprise” means an entity actually operating in the Qianhai Cooperation Zone whose main business falls within the detailed categories of the Trial Statistical Classification of the Low-Altitude Economy and Its Core Industries (NDRC Low-Altitude〔2025〕No. 1676). … Support innovation of Shenzhen–Hong Kong–Macao cross-boundary “first-route” insurance products; encourage Shenzhen–Hong Kong–Macao insurers to develop cross-boundary LAE insurance around cross-boundary low-altitude scenes and to explore mutual recognition of cross-boundary LAE insurance policies.
  :::

[Link](https://gaj.ankang.gov.cn/Content-2949592.html) · [Xinhua](https://www.news.cn/legal/20260930/fa37e5f2fc824e3c99c78fc5a46b5377/c.html)
  - What's new: Nationwide discretionary baseline for police administrative penalties under the Interim Regulations on UAS Flight Management and, where overlapping, Public Security Administration Punishments Law Art. 46(1). Covers five behaviour classes including flying without real-name registration and flying micro/light/small civil UAS in controlled airspace without approval. Criminal liability remains separate where the act constitutes a crime. MPS.gov.cn primary HTML OPEN this run; text verified via local republication.
  - Status: Officially confirmed via local republication of the MPS notice. Mainland enforcement comparator — not Hong Kong law.
  - Read instead: Mainland UAS enforcement comparator; Cap. 448G / HK enforcement contrast.

  ::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="原文 · Chinese original"}
  [「《公安机关依法处置涉无人驾驶航空器违法行为行政处罚裁量基准》已经部长办公会审议通过。现印发给你们，请结合工作实际，认真贯彻执行。」…「公安机关对违反《无人驾驶航空器飞行管理暂行条例》以及同时违反《中华人民共和国治安管理处罚法》第四十六条第一款的违法行为实施行政处罚，适用本裁量基准。对构成犯罪的，依法追究刑事责任。」…「公 安 部 2026年8月26日」]{lang="zh-Hans"} ([source](https://gaj.ankang.gov.cn/Content-2949592.html))

  English (LAE-Intel translation): The Baseline for Administrative Penalties for Handling Unmanned Aircraft System–related Illegal Acts by Public Security Organs has been adopted by the Minister’s office meeting. It is hereby printed and distributed; implement it in light of actual work. … Public security organs applying administrative penalties for violations of the Interim Regulations on Unmanned Aircraft System Flight Management and, concurrently, Article 46(1) of the Public Security Administration Punishments Law of the PRC shall apply this baseline. Where a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be pursued according to law. … Ministry of Public Security, 26 August 2026.
  :::

## 2026-03 {#press-2026-03}

[↑ Back to timeline](#press-timeline){.press-back}

- []{#press-item-2026-03-04-uom .press-item}**4 Mar 2026 · Civil Aviation Administration of China (Announcement 2026 No. 5):** CAAC sets network-style remote-identification requirements for civil UAS systems via the UOM platform; from 1 May 2026 newly produced/sold civil UAS must meet GB 46750-2025 with automatic continuous transmission to UOM and no off switch. [Link](https://www.caac.gov.cn/XXGK/XXGK/TZTG/202603/P020260306730349409250.pdf)
  - What's new: Pre-1 May stock: firmware upgrade where possible; otherwise manufacturers must publish retrofit-module schemes and complete retrofit by 1 Nov 2026. CAAC will publish UOM-connected models. Distinct from the still-draft ATM Rules.
  - Status: In-force CAAC announcement implementing existing regulations / national standard. Not Hong Kong law.
  - Read instead: Dates / Official status: UOM / Mainland RID; [OFCA 1.4 GHz UAS (Private) Licence](#press-item-2025-10-27-uas-licence) (different instrument class).

  ::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="原文 · Chinese original"}
  [「根据《无人驾驶航空器飞行管理暂行条例》《民用无人驾驶航空器运行安全管理规则》《民用无人驾驶航空器系统运行识别规范》（GB46750-2025）有关要求，现将民用无人驾驶航空器系统网络式运行识别要求和相关事项公告如下：」…「自2026年5月1日起，所有民用无人驾驶航空器系统（以下简称“无人机”）生产厂家应确保其生产、销售的无人机具备运行识别发送功能且技术规范完全符合GB46750-2025的要求。运行识别信息由无人机直接向UOM发送，无人机应在依靠自身动力飞行的全过程中保持运行识别信息的自动持续发送，且不应具备关闭发送的功能。」…「中国民用航空局 2026年3月4日」]{lang="zh-Hans"} ([source](https://www.caac.gov.cn/XXGK/XXGK/TZTG/202603/P020260306730349409250.pdf))

  English (LAE-Intel translation): Pursuant to the Interim Regulations on UAS Flight Management, the Rules on Safe Operation Management of Civil UAS, and the Civil UAS System Remote Identification Specification (GB 46750-2025), CAAC hereby announces network-style remote-identification requirements for civil UAS systems. … From 1 May 2026, all manufacturers of civil UAS systems shall ensure UAS they produce and sell have remote-identification sending fully conforming to GB 46750-2025. Identification information shall be sent directly to UOM; the UAS shall keep automatic continuous transmission throughout flight under its own power and shall not have a function to switch sending off. … Civil Aviation Administration of China, 4 March 2026.
  :::

  [「为明确低空经济概念和范畴，明晰产业边界，根据低空经济阶段性特征和重点领域、重点环节，按照统计工作相关规定，编制形成《低空经济及其核心产业统计分类（试行）》。现印发你们，请按此执行。」…「国家发展改革委 2025年12月22日」…「低空经济是依托低空航空活动带动相关产业创新和场景应用形成的综合性经济形态。本分类将低空经济范围确定为：01 低空制造业、02 低空运营业、03 低空基建与信息服务业、04 低空配套业等 4 个大类。」]{lang="zh-Hans"} ([source](https://www.ndrc.gov.cn/xxgk/zcfb/tz/202512/t20251226_1402669.html))

  English (LAE-Intel translation): To clarify the concept and scope of the low-altitude economy and delineate industry boundaries, NDRC has prepared the Trial Statistical Classification of the Low-Altitude Economy and Its Core Industries in light of stage characteristics and key fields/links and in accordance with statistical work rules. It is hereby printed; implement accordingly. … NDRC, 22 December 2025. … The low-altitude economy is a comprehensive economic form formed by innovation and scene applications in related industries driven by low-altitude aviation activities. This classification sets the LAE scope as four major classes: 01 manufacturing; 02 operations; 03 infrastructure and information services; 04 supporting industries.
  :::

- []{#press-item-2025-12-12-caac-ac .press-item}**12 Dec 2025 · Civil Aviation Administration of China (Aircraft Airworthiness Certification Department; portal 15 Dec; comment close 31 Dec):** CAAC seeks comment on draft ACs *Airworthiness Standards for Restricted-Category UAS* and *Airworthiness Standards for Powered-Lift Aircraft*. [Link](https://www.caac.gov.cn/HDJL/YJZJ/202512/t20251215_229408.html)
  - What's new: Two draft advisory circulars to guide type certification for restricted-category UAS systems and powered-lift aircraft. Draft ACs only — not final airworthiness rules.
  - Status: Officially confirmed consultation. Draft only.
  - Read instead: Dates / Official status: CAAC airworthiness; eVTOL / powered-lift TC pathway.

  ::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="原文 · Chinese original"}
  [「为更好指导和规范限用类无人驾驶航空器系统和动力提升航空器型号合格审定工作，结合多个型号合格审定实践经验，民航局航空器适航审定司组织编制了咨询通告《限用类无人驾驶航空器系统适航标准（征求意见稿）》和《动力提升航空器适航标准（征求意见稿）》，现征求公众意见。」…「请于2025年12月31日前……民航局航空器适航审司 2025年12月12日」]{lang="zh-Hans"} ([source](https://www.caac.gov.cn/HDJL/YJZJ/202512/t20251215_229408.html))

  English (LAE-Intel translation): To better guide and standardise type certification of restricted-category UAS systems and powered-lift aircraft, and drawing on multiple type-certification practice cases, CAAC’s Aircraft Airworthiness Certification Department has prepared draft advisory circulars on Airworthiness Standards for Restricted-Category UAS Systems and Airworthiness Standards for Powered-Lift Aircraft, now open for public comment. … Please submit comments by 31 December 2025. … CAAC Aircraft Airworthiness Certification Department, 12 December 2025.
  :::


## 2025-11 {#press-2025-11}

- []{#press-item-2025-11-24-sandbox-x .press-item}**24 Nov 2025 · info.gov.hk / Transport and Logistics Bureau:** Government launches advanced Regulatory Sandbox X for cross-boundary drones, passenger-capable unconventional aircraft and integrated platforms; first-phase UTM applications open to 9 Jan 2026. [Link](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202511/24/P2025112400912.htm) · [中文](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202511/24/P2025112400779.htm)
  - What's new: Foundational Press item for the Sandbox X arc. STL also said Action Plan drafting targeted by end of next year (from that vantage) — still OPEN. First-batch Regulatory Sandbox then described as 38 selected / 29 implemented.
  - Status: Officially confirmed launch. Sandbox X is separate from the Regulatory Sandbox; cross-boundary results OPEN. Action Plan text OPEN.
  - Read instead: Official status / Timeline: Regulatory Sandbox X; Action Plan (OPEN).

  ::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="官方中英文本 · Official English and Chinese"}
  English: “The launch event of the low-altitude economy \"Regulatory Sandbox X\" was held today (November 24)…” … “The goal of \"Regulatory Sandbox X\" is to handle more complex scenarios, such as cross-boundary low altitude drones, unconventional aircraft designed for passenger-carrying, and integrated operation platforms.” … “We will continue to engage with the industry and gather diverse perspectives to enable the drafting of the Action Plan on Developing Low-Altitude Economy by the end of next year.” ([source](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202511/24/P2025112400912.htm))

  [「低空經濟「監管沙盒X」啟動禮今日（十一月二十四日）舉行……當中的 「X」代表擴展 (extended) 和增值 (extra)，是升級版的監管沙盒，旨在處理更複雜的場景，例如跨境低空無人機、可載人航空器和綜合運營平台等。」…「我們期望繼續和業界諮詢並蒐集不同意見，在明年年底前可草擬發展低空經濟規劃行動綱領」]{lang="zh-Hant"} ([source](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202511/24/P2025112400779.htm))
  :::


- []{#press-item-2025-11-03-caac-bio .press-item}**3 Nov 2025 · Civil Aviation Administration of China (Aircraft Airworthiness Certification Department; portal 4 Nov; comment close 21 Nov):** Five-draft industry-standards package including civil UAS cargo packaging requirements and service guide for human biological samples. [Link](https://www.caac.gov.cn/HDJL/YJZJ/202511/t20251104_229033.html)
  - What's new: Standards drafts for UAS carriage of human biological samples (packaging + service guide), plus other CAAC industry standards. Mainland comparator for medical / sample logistics scenes. Draft standards only.
  - Status: Officially confirmed consultation. Draft only.
  - Read instead: Dates / Official status: UAS medical/logistics scenes; CAAC standards stream.

  ::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="原文 · Chinese original"}
  [「按照民航行业标准编制计划，我司组织起草了《民用无人驾驶航空器货物运输包装要求 人类生物样本（征求意见稿）》、《民用无人驾驶航空器人类生物样本运输服务指南（征求意见稿）》……五项民航行业标准……意见征集日期截至11月21日」…「民航局航空器适航审定司 2025年11月3日」]{lang="zh-Hans"} ([source](https://www.caac.gov.cn/HDJL/YJZJ/202511/t20251104_229033.html))

  English (LAE-Intel translation): Under the civil aviation industry standards programme, the department has drafted five CAAC industry standards including Civil UAS Cargo Transport Packaging Requirements — Human Biological Samples (draft) and Civil UAS Human Biological Sample Transport Service Guide (draft). … Comment period closes 21 November. … CAAC Aircraft Airworthiness Certification Department, 3 November 2025.

- []{#press-item-2025-10-29-sz-layout .press-item}**29 Oct 2025 · Shenzhen Planning and Natural Resources Bureau / DRC / Transport Bureau:** Shenzhen jointly issues *Layout Plan for Low-Altitude Aircraft Take-off and Landing Facilities (2026–2035)*. [Link](https://www.sz.gov.cn/cn/xxgk/zfxxgj/ghjh/csgh/zxgh/content/post_12470231.html) · [plan text republication](https://economy.southcn.com/node_e13b7c1f8b/7f6a8ab1d1.shtml)
  - What's new: City planning announcement with PDF annex. Corroborating Southern Media accounts describe a “56 hubs + 1,500 endpoint take-off/landing points” overall layout and near-term priority of 13 hubs. Planning layout — not operational authorisations or evidenced cross-boundary flights. Detailed numeric layout quoted from Southern Media republication alongside the official issuance notice.
  - Status: Officially confirmed issuance; layout figures corroborated via republication. Corridor not evidenced.
  - Read instead: [Dongguan 349N](#press-item-2026-05-20-dongguan).

  ::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="原文 · Chinese original"}
  [「《深圳市低空航空器起降设施布局规划（2026—2035年）》已经市政府同意，现予以印发。」…「深圳市规划和自然资源局 深圳市发展和改革委员会 深圳市交通运输局 2025年10月29日」]{lang="zh-Hans"} ([source](https://www.sz.gov.cn/cn/xxgk/zfxxgj/ghjh/csgh/zxgh/content/post_12470231.html))

  English (LAE-Intel translation): The Shenzhen Layout Plan for Low-Altitude Aircraft Take-off and Landing Facilities (2026–2035) has been agreed by the municipal government and is hereby printed. … Shenzhen Planning and Natural Resources Bureau, Development and Reform Commission, and Transport Bureau, 29 October 2025.
  :::


- []{#press-item-2025-10-27-uas-licence .press-item}**27 Oct 2025 · Communications Authority / OFCA:** CA launches the Unmanned Aircraft System (Private) Licence assigning the 1.4 GHz (1430–1444 MHz) band for Sandbox UAS radiocommunications. [Link](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202510/27/P2025102700178.htm) · [中文](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202510/27/P2025102700172.htm) · [OFCA](https://www.ofca.gov.hk/en/industry_focus/industry_focus/uas_private_licence/index.html)
  - What's new: Opens dedicated UAS spectrum licensing to LAE Regulatory Sandbox participants (CAD flight-path approval required). Aligns channel plan with Mainland 1.4 GHz arrangement (per OFCA materials). Later restated by SCED LegCo panel (6 Oct 2026) — this is the launch primary.
  - Status: Officially confirmed licence regime launch. Not a Sandbox X instrument.
  - Read instead: Official status / Timeline: 1.4 GHz UAS (Private) Licence; [SCED restatement, 6 Oct 2026](#press-2026-10).

  ::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="官方中英文本 · Official English and Chinese"}
  English: “As announced in the 2025 Policy Address, the Government will enhance core infrastructure facilities, including by designating spectrum, to advance Hong Kong as a major hub for low-altitude innovative applications. Under the UAS (Private) Licence regime, licensees will be assigned with the 1430 – 1444 MHz band (1.4 GHz band) as the dedicated spectrum for establishing, maintaining and operating radiocommunications installation for UAS operations.” ([source](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202510/27/P2025102700178.htm))

  [「二○二五年《施政報告》宣布，政府將推展核心基建設施，包括推出專用頻譜，以推動香港成為低空創新應用的核心樞紐。在無人機（專用）牌照制度下，牌照持有人可獲指配1430 – 1444 兆赫頻帶（1.4吉赫頻帶）作為專用頻譜，用於設置、維持及操作用於營運無人機系統的無線電通訊裝置」]{lang="zh-Hant"} ([source](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202510/27/P2025102700172.htm))
  :::

- []{#press-item-2025-10-23-caac-ga .press-item}**23 Oct 2025 · Civil Aviation Administration of China (Transport Department; comment close 22 Nov):** CAAC opens consultation on draft *General Aviation Operations Management Regulations*, revising CCAR-290-R3 in support of GA and LAE rulemaking alongside the Civil Aviation Law revision. [Link](https://www.caac.gov.cn/HDJL/YJZJ/202510/t20251023_228940.html)
  - What's new: Draft departmental regulation reframing GA business licensing toward broader GA operations management. Draft only.
  - Status: Officially confirmed consultation. Draft only. Not Hong Kong law.
  - Read instead: [Civil Aviation Law revise](#press-item-2025-12-27-cal).

  ::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="原文 · Chinese original"}
  [「为加强通用航空和低空经济规章制度体系建设，促进通用航空和低空经济健康安全发展，推进民航法治建设，配合《民航法》修订，按照民航局立法工作安排，在前期征求和吸纳行业及相关部门意见后，民航局运输司修订完善了规章《通用航空经营许可管理规定》（CCAR-290-R3），形成《通用航空经营管理规定》（征求意见稿），现面向社会公开征求意见。」…「请于2025年11月22日前……民航局运输司 2025年10月23日」]{lang="zh-Hans"} ([source](https://www.caac.gov.cn/HDJL/YJZJ/202510/t20251023_228940.html))

  English (LAE-Intel translation): To strengthen the GA and LAE rules system, promote healthy and safe GA and LAE development, advance civil-aviation rule of law, and coordinate with revision of the Civil Aviation Law, CAAC’s Transport Department has revised the departmental regulation on GA Business Licensing Management (CCAR-290-R3) into a draft General Aviation Operations Management Regulation, now open for public comment. … Please comment by 22 November 2025. … CAAC Transport Department, 23 October 2025.
  :::

- []{#press-item-2025-10-13-gd16 .press-item}**13 Oct 2025 · General Office of the People’s Government of Guangdong Province (粤办函〔2025〕268号):** Guangdong issues *Several Measures of Guangdong Province on Supporting High-Quality Development of the Low-Altitude Economy* (16 clauses; effective from release for 3 years). [Link](https://www.gd.gov.cn/gkmlpt/content/4/4788/post_4788687.html)
  - What's new: Provincial support package: airspace release and flight-service platforms; R&D; airworthiness capacity; infrastructure and urban air mobility (GZ/SZ/ZH to pilot intra- and inter-city passenger routes and explore GBA cross-boundary UAS logistics); data and standards; finance and talent. Cross-boundary language is exploration / support — not evidenced SZ–HK operational corridor. No market-size figures quoted.
  - Status: Officially confirmed provincial measures. Corridor not evidenced as operational.
  - Read instead: Official status: SZ–HK corridor (not evidenced); [Shenzhen TOL layout](#press-item-2025-10-29-sz-layout).

  ::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="原文 · Chinese original"}
  [「《广东省支持低空经济高质量发展若干措施》已经省人民政府同意，现印发给你们，请结合实际认真贯彻执行。」…「支持广州、深圳、珠海先行先试，在确保安全的前提下，稳步开通市内和城际低空客运航线，探索制定低空空域交通规则和大湾区跨境无人机物流配送。」…「本措施支持范围包括在我省开展低空经济业务的企业和机构，自发布之日起施行，有效期3年。」…「省政府办公厅 2025年10月13日」]{lang="zh-Hans"} ([source](https://www.gd.gov.cn/gkmlpt/content/4/4788/post_4788687.html))

  English (LAE-Intel translation): The Several Measures of Guangdong Province on Supporting High-Quality Development of the Low-Altitude Economy have been agreed by the provincial people’s government and are hereby printed; implement them earnestly in light of actual conditions. … Support Guangzhou, Shenzhen and Zhuhai in taking the lead: on the premise of safety, steadily open intra-city and inter-city low-altitude passenger routes, and explore formulating low-altitude airspace traffic rules and GBA cross-boundary UAS logistics delivery. … The Measures cover enterprises and institutions conducting LAE business in the province, take effect from the date of release, and remain valid for three years. … General Office of the Provincial Government, 13 October 2025.
  :::
